The duo instead served as directors and co-wrote the film, along with Daft Arts manager Paul Hahn and collaborator Cédric Hervet. Members of Halifax's State Champs and Truro's The Motes formed North of America in 1997. According to the liner notes for the band's debut album "The Chinkees Are Coming!" , the music was recorded by members of the band Tuesday with vocals provided by Mike Park.  Subsequent albums were recorded all or in part by members Park, Miya Osaki, Greg Alesandro, Jason Thinh, and Steve Choi, as well as "guest" musicians, including Slapstick and Tuesday drummer Rob Kellenberger and Link 80's Steve Borth, often with members trading and playing different instruments than listed.  All of the members were involved with the ska/punk scene.  Jason Thinh was from the band Short Round, Miya was a member of the Santa Cruz punk trio The Muggs, Greg Alesandro a member of San Jose band Statue Man, and Steve Choi later becoming a keyboardist and guitarist for Rx Bandits in 1999.
Zoetrope (album) | Zoetrope is an album released in 2002 by the dark ambient musician Lustmord on the Nextera record label.  The album is a soundtrack to the experimental psychological horror film of the same name.
